title: Integral of the Squared Unit Pulse Function
expert_review: A mathematically rigorous look at the $L^2$ properties of pulse functions. It effectively demonstrates why the Dirac Delta function is a distribution and not a standard function.
source: Signal Theory and Linear Systems - Chapter 3
learning_objectives: Calculate the integral of a squared parameter-dependent function
Analyze the limit of an expression as its denominator approaches zero
Distinguish between area-preserving and energy-preserving transformations
Understand the mathematical limitations of squaring a Dirac-like pulse
